entries.description: Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, and data-classification-plan.md.

Registered session start via ai_router.register_session_start; later patched session-state.json to the canonical v4 shape per CLAUDE.md (and added back v2 top-level fields as a bridge for the installed close_session).

Designed the classification.json schema in-conversation per the project-guidance convention 'When the orchestrator's model matches the routing target for a given task type, handle the task in-conversation rather than calling route().' Orchestrator is claude-opus-4-7 and architecture routes to opus.

Wrote AccessHarvester.Pipeline/Classification/classification-schema.json (Draft-07, 10-category ColumnCategory enum, MaskingStrategy enum, single-column FkTarget with explicit v1.0 scope note, FK-authority if/then constraint, valueFormatPattern allOf-of-two-regex constraints) and samples/classification-fixture.json (HomeHealthCare-shape: Person + VisitStatus + Visit covering all 10 categories and the FK/autonumber/memo/audit edge cases).

Validated samples/classification-fixture.json against the schema (Draft-07 Python jsonschema): 0 errors. Ran positive/negative tests on the FK if/then constraint and the valueFormatPattern regex after each fix round.

Round 1 cross-provider session-verification via route(task_type='session-verification') -> gpt-5-4. Verdict: ISSUES_FOUND. 1 Critical (privacy invariant on valueFormatPattern) + 2 Major (single-column FK scope ambiguity; FK-authority human-override ambiguity).

Applied R1 fixes: regex pattern on valueFormatPattern; FkTarget single-column scope note in schema-root and FkTarget descriptions; allOf if/then constraint on Column humanOverride for isForeignKey=true. R2 verification gpt-5-4 verdict ISSUES_FOUND on residual valueFormatPattern weakness (all-uppercase literals slip past).

Tightened valueFormatPattern: allOf of two regex rules (char-class allowlist + at-least-one-placeholder). Narrowed privacy-invariant scope to scanner-emitted fields and clarified reviewer-discipline expectation for notes. R3 gpt-5-4 verdict ISSUES_FOUND on placeholder-alphabet ambiguity (A/X are both placeholders AND legitimate uppercase letters).

Collapsed placeholder alphabet to non-alphabetic tokens only (# and ?); removed letter-class placeholders. R4 gpt-5-4 verdict ISSUES_FOUND on a contrived all-uppercase + placeholder residual ('APT #B').

Per Step 7 disagreement procedure: queried gemini-pro for a tiebreaker on the R4 finding; tiebreaker endorsed dismissal ('the significant, certain engineering cost of re-architecting the contract... is not justified by the minimal, theoretical risk reduction'). Operator confirmed option (b) accept-dismissal. Recorded via ai_router.record_adjudication (cause=genuine-split, resolution=accept-dismissal). Issue saved to issue-logs/session-001.json with status=deferred.

Routed Session 2 orchestrator recommendation via route(task_type='analysis') -> gemini-pro. Recommendation: claude-sonnet-4-6 at effort=high (mechanical-correspondence pin per project-guidance; key architectural decisions already documented in plan section 3 + 8).
Appended Session 1 actuals to ai-assignment.md (orchestrator used, total routed cost ~$0.69, deviations, calibration notes) and updated the Session 2 block per the routed recommendation.

Authored docs/session-sets/harvester-data-classifier/disposition.json with status=completed, next_orchestrator block (claude-sonnet-4-6 high, reason=switch-due-to-cost), and the full files_changed list per the lessons-learned 'write disposition before closeout commit' convention.

Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, data-classification-plan.md § 3 + § 8, the Session 1 schema and fixture, and the Session 2 block of ai-assignment.md. Registered session start via ai_router.register_session_start (which wrote v2 shape on disk); restored the hybrid v4+v2 session-state.json shape per the user's installed-router-vs-canonical-router workaround (feedback_session_state_hybrid_shape memory).

Implemented AccessHarvester.Pipeline/Classification/: ScanConfig, PiiDictionary (Presidio-seeded patterns + glob compiler), RawSchema (DTO), ClassificationFinding (10-category taxonomy + table-hint enum + kebab-case wire mapping), ValueFormatDetector (canonical format pattern with schema-conformant rules), HeuristicsEngine (pure-logic classification with lookup detection, PII veto, system-audit detection, lookup-payload promotion), ClassificationWriter (JSON serializer with editor-default humanOverride blocks), ClassificationRunner (interface-driven pipeline + degradation channel), ISchemaReader/IValueSampler interfaces, ClassificationDegradation/IDegradationReporter for the partial-failure channel.

Implemented AccessHarvester.Core/Com/OleDbDaoSchemaReader (OLE DB GetOleDbSchemaTable for TABLES/COLUMNS/PRIMARY_KEYS/FOREIGN_KEYS with ACE 16.0->12.0 provider fallback + DAO via AccessComSession for AutoNumber attribute, combo-box RowSource implicit FK, linked-table flagging, multi-value field detection) and OleDbValueSampler (Jet/ACE subquery cardinality, value sampling that never leaks raw values, defensive bracketed-identifier escaper rejecting ]/NUL/CR/LF). Added System.Data.OleDb 9.0.0 PackageReference to AccessHarvester.Core.csproj.

Authored AccessHarvester.Cli/Commands/ClassifyCommand.cs (--in/--out/--exclude-cleanup/--json-status; --exclude-cleanup honours the same uat-checklist-editor Review[Passes=true] format as identify-usage/identify-cleanup). Wired classify subcommand into Program.cs dispatch table, bare-file exclusion set, and usage text.

Wrote hermetic unit tests under tests/AccessHarvester.Pipeline.Tests/Classification/: PiiDictionaryTests (glob anchoring + value-regex coverage), ValueFormatDetectorTests (consistent shape, literal+digit, null on disagreement, schema-conformant output), HeuristicsEngineTests (autonumber PK, FK, PII name+value, quasi-id DOB, memo, thin lookup, PII veto, system-audit recurrence requirement, linked tables, referenced-by informational only, deterministic table order), ClassificationWriterTests (writer output schema-validates, scanner-default humanOverride emitted, ISO 8601 UTC scannedUtc, kebab-case wire forms). Wrote OleDbValueSamplerIdentifierEscapingTests for the defensive escaper.

Wrote tests/AccessHarvester.Integration/Cli/ClassifyCommandTests.cs: [SkippableFact] end-to-end test that runs the published CLI against samples/HomeHealthCare.accdb and asserts schema-conformant output + privacy invariant (empty notes) + --json-status envelope; two negative-case tests for missing --in and nonexistent database. Added RunWithTimeout overload to CliInvoker so COM-heavy invocations have a 240s budget.

dotnet build -c Debug then dotnet test (sequential per project-guidance). Initial build needed System.Collections.Generic/System/Linq using directives in every new Pipeline file (Pipeline does not enable ImplicitUsings). Full test run green: 131 + 9 + 85 + 294 + 400 + 637 + 70 + 447 (2 skipped, 1 SkippableFact skipped on no-Access host) + 48 = ~1900 passed.

Round 1 cross-provider session-verification via route(task_type='session-verification') -> gpt-5-4 (cost $0.384). Verdict ISSUES_FOUND: 4 Major + 1 Minor — lookup-reference category never emitted; DAO RCW cleanup incomplete; SQL identifier escaping + over-broad sampler catches; TryRead*Property too broad; fkTarget.column='*' placeholder + Degradations channel unused.

Applied all 5 R1 fixes: post-pass lookup-reference promotion in HeuristicsEngine; paired finally RCW releases in OleDbDaoSchemaReader.ReadDaoAugmentations (currentDb, tableDefs, fields, td, fd, propsObj, propObj); EscapeIdentifier helper + narrowed per-query catches that surface DegradationKind.SamplingError; TryRead*Property narrowed to catch(COMException); new ClassificationDegradation + IDegradationReporter contract + ResolveImplicitFk that refuses to fabricate column names + DetectCompositeFks for composite-FK degradations + ClassifyCommand exit 3 with full --json-status surface. Added unit tests for the lookup-payload promotion + the identifier escaper. R2 gpt-5-4 verdict ISSUES_FOUND (cost $0.387): 2 Major + 2 Minor — lookup promotion missed sensitive-non-pii-from-format-pattern; rejected identifier aborted scan; TryRead*Property still caught all COMException; composite-FK fallback false-positive.

Applied all 4 R2 fixes: lookup-promotion guard switched from positive allowlist to negative exclusion list; EscapeIdentifier calls moved inside per-table/per-column try/catch that converts ArgumentException to SamplingError degradation; TryRead*Property gained a when(DaoPropertyAbsentHResults.Contains(ex.HResult)) filter restricted to DAO HRESULTs 0x800A0CC1 and 0x800A0CB3; DetectCompositeFks fallback removed — composite degradation only emitted when FK_NAME is populated. Added Lookup_payload_promotion_includes_format_pattern_sensitive_columns test. R3 gpt-5-4 verdict VERIFIED (cost $0.233): all four R2 fixes confirmed; no new findings; no regressions; privacy invariant intact.
Wrote issue-logs/session-002.json covering all three rounds (R1 5 issues all fixed, R2 4 issues all fixed, R3 VERIFIED) with status=fixed and per-issue fixSummary.

Routed Session 3 orchestrator recommendation via route(task_type='analysis') -> gemini-pro (cost $0.009). Recommendation: claude-sonnet-4-6 at effort=normal (mechanical correspondence: single-file HTML/JS editor from finalised JSON schema; per project-guidance Pin-mechanical-correspondence-to-Sonnet convention).

Appended Session 2 actuals to ai-assignment.md (orchestrator used = claude-opus-4-7 medium with operator override of the routed Sonnet-high recommendation, total routed cost ~$1.01, deviations note, calibration notes including the new lesson-candidate about RCW + SQL escaping being routine R1 findings on COM-heavy code). Updated Session 3 block with the routed Sonnet-normal recommendation.

Authored docs/session-sets/harvester-data-classifier/disposition.json with status=completed, full files_changed list (15 new + 7 modified), next_orchestrator block (claude-sonnet-4-6 normal, reason=switch-due-to-cost), blockers=[].
